Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: add contextual outfit, CTA smile, and B-ROLL ethnicity

1. Outfit - LLM + constrained categories + cache:
   - Add COSTUME_CATEGORIES \(50+ categories\) for consistent outfit selection
   - Add getContextualOutfitAsync\(\) with LLM classification + DB cache
   - Create topic_outfit_cache table for caching outfit decisions

2. CTA expression - always friendly/smile:
   - Add CTA_EMOTION_OVERRIDE constant
   - Add getEmotionSpecsWithOverride\(\) function
   - CTA/ENDING_CTA segments now always use warm smile expression

3. B-ROLL ethnicity - language-based:
   - Add LANGUAGE_ETHNICITY_MAP \(id/hi/en -> ethnicity\)
   - Add getEthnicityForLanguage\(\) with full name support \(indonesian, hindi, etc\)
   - Add buildEthnicityPrompt\(\) for injection
   - Frontend passes language to all generate-images API calls
   - handleProcessSingle injects/replaces ethnicity in B-ROLL prompts

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
